fomod.Name: OStim Together
fomod.Author: OStim Together project
fomod.Description: Synchronizes OStim Standalone scenes through Skyrim Together Reborn using STRPluginMessagingAPI. v0.32.0 unifies remote scene positioning around one OStim anchor pipeline: real furniture is reused when present, while furniture-free and wall scenes receive an invisible temporary XMarkerHeading at the authoritative scene center and are started through the same ThreadBuilder furniture-anchor path. Includes mandatory pre-UI consent, native multi-master scene controls, participant-authored alignment, safe orphan cleanup, OCum live synchronization, and coalesced RaceMenu overlay rebuilds.
